answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because lagoon only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, atlas is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any zephyr approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
